characteristics: range up to 50km with guided projectile, 18km conventional
Strength: Widely available across NATO stockpiles, giving a large parts/ammunition supply base
Limitation: Lighter armor and shorter baseline range than PzH2000; older chassis design
Estimated quantity available: Delivered in significant numbers across multiple donor nations
employment_notes: One of the most numerous donated SPG types by simple availability across many donor nations' surplus stocks
contrast_vs_traditional: Older than Caesar or PzH 2000 and correspondingly slower to displace, the Paladin illustrates the same doctrine.md pressure from the other side: legacy self-propelled guns built around Cold War-era counter-battery timelines are simply less matched to a fight where the response to a firing signature can arrive in minutes rather than the tens of minutes those platforms were designed to tolerate.
